Asset type: final single mascot PNG cutout for a native macOS notch companion app called Coucou, ready for later sprite animation.
Input image: reference concept board, use ONLY the large ghost on the right as the visual identity reference, not the typography, panels, cube, ball or explanatory layout.
Primary request: create ONE exquisite production-quality 3D astral glass ghost mascot, a perfected faithful realization of that reference. Full body, front-facing, perfectly centered symmetrical neutral idle pose, orthographic view with a little physical volume visible. Body occupies 80% of square canvas height with generous transparent safety margin on every side.
Subject: adorable calm intelligent floating spirit, soft rounded dome head merging into a plump smooth tapered ghost body with exactly THREE rounded scallops at the bottom. Two tiny rounded floating arms resting at its sides, visually attached or extremely close. No legs, no separate head, no flame tuft, no ears, no clothes. A single small softly glowing icy white four-point energy star floats INSIDE the LOWER BELLY BELOW the eyes, subtle and subordinate to the face.
Materials: luminous pearlescent frosted glass / translucent opalescent jelly, pale icy blue with restrained lilac refraction along the sides, sculptural soft volumetric subsurface scattering, enough silver-blue body density to remain visible on both black UI and white UI. Smooth controlled studio reflections, delicate sharp rim highlights, beautiful interior depth. Not photorealistic ice, not chrome or plastic.
Lighting: premium soft studio lighting upper left, subtle cool inner light, finite restrained glow that does not wash out silhouette or make a huge halo. All glow must fade into true alpha.
Composition: single isolated mascot only. Face forward, hovering, clean full silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow plane, no backdrop, no black or white background, no checkerboard drawn in the image. No text, lettering, watermark, interface, diagram, props, laptop, tablet, platform, extra mascot or extra objects. This is a clean master asset not a concept sheet. Strong iconic silhouette, calm and delightful, suitable for premium dark macOS UI. Match the reference's translucent ghost quality and luminous WHITE eyes, NOT a rounded square icon with black eyes.
